details:
I'd like a way to rate world quality, including a downvote, so that low-effort worlds rank lower in search, Discover, and recommendation rows.

To be clear, I'm not against AI. I think creators should use AI tools as much as they like. The issue is quality, not how a world was made: low-effort "slop" worlds, whether AI-generated or made by hand, are filling search results and making good worlds harder to find. Right now there is no way to signal "this world is low quality", only favoriting (positive) or reporting (rule violations). Most slop worlds don't break any rules, so reporting is the wrong tool, but they still shouldn't rank as high as well-made worlds.

Requested features:

1. A quality downvote (or a simple up/down rating) on world pages.

2. Use these ratings in search ranking and recommendations, with protections against brigading (for example, only counting users who actually spent time in the world).

3. Keep it separate from reporting, since this is about quality, not rule violations.

This would reward effort and quality regardless of whether a creator uses AI.
title: Add a quality rating (downvote) for worlds so low-effort "slop" ranks lower
